clips.send: Each star feels the pull of the others. We choose model units for distance, mass and time so the gravity constant G has a value of 1. The clock counts model seconds. Velocity Verlet updates the motion every 0.0005 model seconds. In B and C, a softening length ε equals 0.008 keeps acceleration finite during close passes. In A and the two-star preset, ε equals 0 gives ordinary Newtonian gravity. The line in the sky view marks the distance r between stars 1 and 2. Move the time slider to see how much acceleration star 2 alone gives star 1. The mass of star 2 is m2.

clips.send: In an ideal, isolated pair, two bound stars that do not collide keep tracing ellipses around their shared center of mass. A circle is a special ellipse. Try the two-star control and see whether the stars retrace their paths. As the three stars move, all their pulls change. There’s no simple general formula for their motion from arbitrary starting conditions. Henri Poincaré’s work revealed how complicated the motion can get. In chaos (混沌, hùndùn), tiny differences at the start can grow into big differences later, even under the same rules.

clips.send: Alpha Centauri is the closest star system to ours. Stars A and B form a close pair, and Proxima Centauri orbits much farther out. Preset B shows this arrangement with a smaller difference in orbit sizes so you can see both at once. Picture two massive bodies circling each other. There are five special positions where a much lighter spacecraft can move along with them and keep the same position relative to both. In this circular-orbit model, those positions are called Lagrange points. Measurements of temperature and wind always have some uncertainty. Like the 0.001 shift in the butterfly experiment, tiny starting differences can grow as the atmosphere moves. Research puts the limit for day-to-day forecasts in midlatitudes, where much of the United States lies, at about two weeks. Liu Cixin’s The Three-Body Problem is a science-fiction novel for older readers. It won the 2015 Hugo Award for Best Novel. Its Trisolaran world has three suns. During Stable Eras, days and nights follow a pattern. During Chaotic Eras, sunrise and temperature become unpredictable.

clips.send: 在理想情况下，两颗相互束缚且不相撞的恒星会一直沿着椭圆轨道绕共同质心运行，圆也是椭圆的一种。试试“双星对照”，看看两颗星是否会回到原来的轨迹上。三颗星的位置不断改变，它们对彼此的拉力也跟着变。没有一个简单的通用公式能算出任意初始状态下三颗星的运动。庞加莱的研究揭示了这种运动可以有多复杂。“混沌”指的是：即使遵循同样的规律，起点的微小差别也可能在以后变成很大的差别。

clips.send: 三颗质量相同的恒星沿同一条轨道依次运行。观察它们怎样轮流经过交叉点。Chenciner 和 Montgomery 在 2000 年发表了这种轨道存在的证明。

clips.send: 每颗星都受到其余恒星的引力。模型选取距离、质量和时间单位，使引力常量 G 的数值等于 1。这里的“秒”是模拟时间单位。程序用速度 Verlet 法，每隔 0.0005 模拟秒更新一次。预设 B 和 C 使用软化长度 ε 等于 0.008，使极近时的加速度仍为有限值。预设 A 和双星对照取 ε 等于 0，直接使用牛顿引力。图中的线段标出 1 号星和 2 号星的间距 r。把时间滑块往前拖，观察 2 号星单独对 1 号星产生的加速度怎样变化。m2 是 2 号星的质量。

clips.send: 半人马座 α 星系统离太阳系最近。A 星和 B 星组成一对双星，比邻星则在远处绕这对双星运行。预设 B 展示了这种结构，特意缩小了内外轨道的大小差距，方便在同一幅图上观察。设两个大天体沿圆轨道互相绕转。模型中有五个特殊位置，质量很小的航天器可以在这些位置与两个大天体一起绕转，并与它们保持相同的相对位置。这五个位置叫作拉格朗日点。气温、风速等测量值总会有一点误差。就像蝴蝶效应实验里那 0.001 个单位的偏差，这些误差可能在大气运动中逐渐放大。研究估计，中纬度地区（如美国大部分地区）的逐日天气，可预报时限大约是两周。刘慈欣的《三体》是一部适合年龄稍大读者的科幻小说，获 2015 年雨果奖最佳长篇小说奖。三体世界有三个太阳。在“恒纪元”，昼夜较有规律。到了“乱纪元”，日出和冷暖就难以预料。
